metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented in `output/` with Node.js standard library only, runnable as requested:

- Entry point: [main.js](/workspace/output/main.js)
- Supporting modules:
  - [parser_bib.js](/workspace/output/parser_bib.js)
  - [parser_bst.js](/workspace/output/parser_bst.js)
  - [runtime.js](/workspace/output/runtime.js)

What it now does:

- CLI flags implemented: `--bib`, `--style`, `--cites`, `--aux`, `--output`, `--log`
- Reads cite keys from both `--cites` and `--aux` (concatenate then dedupe)
- Parses `.bib` (`@entry`, `@string`, `@preamble`, `@comment`)
- Parses `.bst` top-level commands and function bodies
- Executes a BibTeX-like stack interpreter with control flow and built-ins used by canonical styles
- Handles citation selection, missing cited keys tracking, macro expansion, and one-step `crossref` inheritance
- Produces `.bbl` output (UTF-8, LF) and wraps lines at 79 columns
- Writes structured JSON log (`--log`) with required counters and warning array
- On parse/runtime failure, writes required JSON error object to `--output` and exits with code `1`
- Uses exit code `2` for unexpected internal errors

You can run it as:

```bash
node /workspace/output/main.js --bib <file.bib> --style <file.bst> --cites <keys.txt> --output <out.bbl> --log <run.json>
```

or with AUX parsing:

```bash
node /workspace/output/main.js --bib <file.bib> --style <file.bst> --aux <file.aux> --output <out.bbl> --log <run.json>
```
